# CBA Ingredients

> CBA Ingredients Company is a Saudi-based B2B wholesale trading, distribution, and supply company for food ingredients and raw materials, located in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. It supplies food businesses across Saudi Arabia and also supports international B2B enquiries.

The website is available in English and Arabic.

## Company

- Legal name: CBA Ingredients Company (also written "CBA Ingredients")
- Website: https://cbaingredients.com/
- Address: Building 5283, King Fahad ibn Abdulaziz Rd, 1st Industrial District, Dammam 32234, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
- Email: alimansour@cbaingredients.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +966 55 658 5552
- Primary market: Saudi Arabia; international B2B enquiries welcome

## Ingredient categories

- Dairy ingredients
- Beverage functional ingredients
- Bakery ingredients
- Coffee shop ingredients
- Flavours
- Natural colours
- Artificial colours
- Butter
- Chocolate
- Restaurant ingredients
- Pharmaceutical and cosmetic products

## Customers served

Restaurants, chain restaurants, coffee shops, fast food outlets, hotels, catering services, cloud kitchens, bakeries, and food manufacturers.
